source: UK GDPR Article 9(2)(a) to (j). Condition (g) asks for a Data Protection Act 2018 Schedule 1 condition by name. This file does not encode every Schedule 1 paragraph. Decision-support only, not legal advice.

conditions.name: Explicit consent
conditions.summary: The data subject has given explicit consent for one or more specified purposes.

required_evidence.description: Explicit consent is recorded for this special category processing.
Consent names the specified purpose, separate from a general privacy notice.
The data subject can withdraw consent.

conditions.name: Employment, social security and social protection
conditions.summary: Processing is necessary for employment, social security, or social protection obligations or rights, and is authorised by law or a collective agreement with appropriate safeguards.

required_evidence.description: The purpose is an employment, social security, or social protection obligation or right.
Cite the UK law or collective agreement that authorises this processing.
Appropriate safeguards for the data subject's rights are in place.

conditions.name: Vital interests
conditions.summary: Processing is necessary to protect the vital interests of the data subject or another person, and the data subject is physically or legally incapable of giving consent.

required_evidence.description: Processing is necessary to protect life.
The data subject is physically or legally incapable of giving consent.

conditions.name: Not-for-profit body
conditions.summary: A not-for-profit body with a political, philosophical, religious, or trade union aim processes data about members, former members, or people in regular contact, and does not disclose it outside the body without consent.

required_evidence.description: State the aim: political, philosophical, religious, or trade union.
Processing relates only to members, former members, or people in regular contact with the body.
Data is not disclosed outside the body without the data subject's consent.
The body has appropriate safeguards for this processing.

conditions.name: Manifestly made public
conditions.summary: The personal data were manifestly made public by the data subject.

required_evidence.description: The data subject themselves made this data public. Disclosure by someone else does not qualify.

conditions.name: Legal claims
conditions.summary: Processing is necessary to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims, or a court is acting in its judicial capacity.

required_evidence.description: Processing is necessary for a legal claim or for a court acting judicially.
Identify the claim, proceeding, or judicial function.

conditions.name: Substantial public interest
conditions.summary: Processing is necessary for reasons of substantial public interest, on the basis of UK law that is proportionate and has suitable safeguards. Name the Data Protection Act 2018 Schedule 1 condition. Individual Schedule 1 paragraphs are not encoded here.

required_evidence.description: Name the Data Protection Act 2018 Schedule 1 substantial public interest condition relied on.
Cite the UK law that provides the substantial public interest basis.
Suitable and specific safeguards for the data subject's rights are in place.
State whether an appropriate policy document is in place where Schedule 1 requires one.

conditions.name: Health or social care
conditions.summary: Processing is necessary for preventive or occupational medicine, working-capacity assessment, medical diagnosis, health or social care, or the management of those systems, subject to Article 9(3) professional secrecy.

required_evidence.description: The purpose is health or social care as described in Article 9(2)(h).
Article 9(3): processing is by, or under the responsibility of, a person subject to professional secrecy.
Processing rests on UK law or a contract with a health professional.

conditions.name: Public health
conditions.summary: Processing is necessary for public interest in public health, such as serious health threats or standards for health care, medicines, or medical devices, with suitable safeguards including professional secrecy.

required_evidence.description: Describe the public health purpose.
Cite the UK law that provides for this public health processing.
Suitable safeguards are in place, including professional secrecy where it applies.

conditions.name: Archiving, research or statistics
conditions.summary: Processing is necessary for archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistics, in accordance with Article 89(1) and UK law.

required_evidence.description: State whether the purpose is archiving, scientific or historical research, or statistics.
Article 89(1) safeguards are in place.
Cite the UK law that authorises this processing.
